page.layout: One page of text in a single column; line numbers 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50 in the left margin; short notes in the right margin; a verse passage of eight-plus lines set in the lower half, with the signature "Aemilia" at its right end.

ca sic Hadrianus Cardinalis:
Urbs antiqua, ingens, Etruscà Regia quondam
Felsina; tum Boii fato irrumpentibus impar,
Accepisse novum fertur Boionia nomen:
Verum ubi suns Boij Romano milite pulsi,
Barbariem excusat, capitque Bononia dici.
Subditur ad Boream radicibus Apennini,
Planicie adclive procumbens Solis ad ortus,
Inter aquas Sapinae & Rheni; quarum utraque in Urbem
Ducta vehit revehitque rates, pistrinaque versat,
Aemilia

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right (Medici, Historici, Philosophi, Arithmetici, Astrologi, Chiromantia, Oratores & Poeta, Antiquarij, Architecti, Pictores, Statuarij, Mulieres litteratae, Militiae Duces, Bononia Initia Oratoris) were not transcribed. Several names in the body are doubtful due to the faint, blurred print. Page is set in roman and italic; the verse block is italic.
